label: Yealink T46U
description: Yealink SIP-T46U executive desk phone with a 4.3-inch colour display, 16 SIP accounts and Yealink Optima HD voice, built on a two-port Gigabit Ethernet switch whose second RJ45 is a PC passthrough. It is a wired-only endpoint out of the box - the LAN port is the PoE input, there is no radio in the chassis, and Wi-Fi or Bluetooth only appears if a WF40/WF50 or BT40/BT41 USB dongle is fitted.
notes: Datasheet: 'The SIP-T46U comes with two Gigabit Ethernet ports, one of which is suitable for Power over Ethernet (PoE)', feature list 'Dual-port Gigabit Ethernet', 'PoE support'. The datasheet does not print the PoE class, so 12.95 W is carried as the 802.3af PD ceiling. Radios: none in the chassis - 'Wi-Fi via WF40/WF50', 'Bluetooth via BT40/BT41/BT51' are USB dongles and the two USB 2.0 ports are not modelled, so the phone presents as a wired endpoint with a passthrough. Provisioning RPS/auto-P, TLS/SRTP, 802.1X, LLDP/CDP/DHCP-VLAN, OpenVPN/L2TP, IPv6. Pair with the T54W already in the catalogue to contrast a wired-only T4U against the Wi-Fi T54W.
